summary: AVISION ONE Website (Next.js 15 on :3001) iter-1 smoke + integration tests. 28/29 pytest assertions PASS. All 17 routes return expected HTTP codes (16 x 200 + intentional 404). Home page renders live CMS data: hero title = banners_home[0].title ('Banking Complete Pack'), 6 featured video courses, 4 live batches with 'Live' badges, testimonials show seeded students Riya Sen & Aditya Kumar. Course detail SEO on /courses/vc-ibps-po-2026 correctly wires product.seo.title into <title> and product.seo.desc into <meta name=description>. /about pulls content from cms_web_pages seed. Contact form has name/email/phone/message fields and mailto:support@avision.co.in action. Heartbeat integration verified: POST /api/heartbeat with client=website works, and admin GET /api/admin/system/status returns frontend.website.status == 'connected'. ONE bug: /sitemap.xml is missing all product-detail URLs (/courses/<id>, /live-courses/<id>). Root cause: sitemap.ts calls listProducts({limit:500}) but the backend enforces limit<=200 (Pydantic 422), which is silently swallowed by the catch{} block. Operational note: during initial parallel curl burst, Next.js dev server produced 'Cannot find module ./124.js' webpack-chunk cache corruption for every route — resolved by rm -rf /app/website/.next && supervisorctl restart website. Not a production issue (only affects dev server under load), but the dev cache is fragile.

integration_issues.issue: Sitemap is missing every /courses/<id> and /live-courses/<id> URL. Root cause: /app/website/src/app/sitemap.ts:24 calls listProducts({type:'video_course', limit:500}) and same for live_course. Backend GET /api/products enforces limit<=200 (Pydantic 422). The listProducts helper then throws, and the surrounding try/catch{} in sitemap.ts swallows the error silently, so no product URLs are appended. Fix: reduce limit to <=200 or paginate. Verified backend returns {"detail":[{"type":"less_than_equal","loc":["query","limit"],"ctx":{"le":200}}]} for limit=500.

action_items: Fix /app/website/src/app/sitemap.ts: change limit:500 → limit:200 (or add pagination) in the two listProducts calls, so /courses/<id> and /live-courses/<id> URLs appear in /sitemap.xml.
Consider surfacing errors from the catch{} blocks in sitemap.ts (at least console.error) so silent failures like this are caught during development.

Ingress note: :3001 is not exposed via preview URL. If a public smoke-test is required, either add ingress for /website or NGINX reverse-proxy /api → 8001, everything else → 3001 on the same origin (already noted in AVISION_ONE_PHASE2_ITERATION1.md §6).
Optional: pre-build the site (`yarn build && yarn start`) in supervisor once iteration stabilises — dev server webpack cache proved fragile under concurrent load in this pod.
critical_code_review_comments: sitemap.ts uses `catch {}` (empty) on all three try blocks — hides real failures. Should log at minimum.
src/lib/api.ts `listProducts` allows any `limit` value from callers; consider clamping to backend max (200) inside the helper to prevent this class of bug.

HeartbeatBeacon fires from client-side only (see components/HeartbeatBeacon.tsx). Server-side page renders don't post a heartbeat. Currently OK because backend/tests still see heartbeat via any SSR-side fetch chain? — verified working: the client-side beacon fires on / and flips System Status to connected. Just noting: if headless SEO crawlers ever hit the site without executing JS, they won't heartbeat. Fine for iter-1.

rca_of_issue: Bug: /sitemap.xml missing product URLs. Reproduction: curl -s http://localhost:3001/sitemap.xml | grep -c 'courses/vc-' → 0. RCA: /app/website/src/app/sitemap.ts lines 23-28 → listProducts({limit:500}) → /app/website/src/lib/api.ts apiGet builds ?limit=500 → backend /api/products validates limit<=200 → 422 error → apiGet throws → outer try/catch{} in sitemap.ts silently swallows → no product URLs appended. Verified with: `curl -s 'http://localhost:8001/api/products?type=video_course&client=website&limit=500'` returns the 422 detail; with limit=100 returns 10 products correctly. Mitigation: change limit:500 → limit:200 in sitemap.ts (both listProducts calls) OR paginate; also improve catch to log so this class of failure is visible.
